title: Applicability boundaries of NMF detrital-zircon unmixing — reproducibility package
description: Code and data accompanying Pan, L., "Where does detrital-zircon source unmixing break? An analytic identifiability criterion and its large-scale Monte-Carlo verification for NMF provenance unmixing" (submitted to Sedimentary Geology). Reproduces every figure: the synthetic data generator, the HPC scan harness (supervised and unsupervised KL-NMF), the merge and figure-generation scripts, the identifiability-theory verification scripts (direct sigma_err measurement on the (rho, n) plane) and their bias/RMSE decomposition, the per-axis results, the per-cell 3D phase-atlas summary, and the real-sample a-priori screen (Fig. 8) with fifteen real per-grain detrital-zircon age samples (Cretaceous Songliao Basin; Jurassic-Lower Cretaceous northern North China Craton margin). Code and synthetic results: MIT licence. The real age samples are redistributed under their original open licences (CC-BY or equivalent) with per-sample attribution; they are not re-licensed as MIT. v1.2.0 adds analysis/bias_rmse.py, analysis/pop_kl_example.py, the graphical-abstract script, corrected figure scripts (Fig. 2 cell edges, Fig. 5 1-sigma noise label, Fig. 8 annotation) and re-rendered figures; see CHANGELOG.md. The full per-seed atlas raw (559 MB; 187 MB gzipped) is archived as a separate data record.
